title: 🎨 Palette: [UX improvement]
description:
* 💡 What: Replaced static generic ARIA labels on user table action buttons with dynamic labels including the user's name or email.
* 🎯 Why: To provide clear, specific context for screen reader users navigating through repeated action buttons in lists.
* 📸 Before/After: N/A
* ♿ Accessibility: Improved screen reader navigation by ensuring each button clearly identifies which user it affects.
